sn14.31:1.2: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || || 3
sn14.31:1.3: Ko nu kho pathavīdhātuyā assādo ko ādinavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn14.31:1.4: ko āpodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn14.31:1.5: ko tejodhātuyā assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn14.31:1.6: ko vāyodhātuyā assādo ko adīnavo kim nissaraṇanti || || 4
sn14.31:2.2: Yaṃ kho pathavīdhātum paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || ayam pathavīdhātuyā assādo || ||
sn14.31:2.3: Yaṃ pathavīdhātuyā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā || ayam pathavīdhātuyā ādīnavo ||
sn14.31:2.4: Yaṃ pathavīdhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ || idam pathavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ || || 6
sn14.31:2.7: Yaṃ vāyodhātum paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā assādo || ||
sn14.31:2.8: Yaṃ vāyodhatuyā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā || ayaṃ vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo || ||
sn14.31:2.9: Yaṃ vāyodhātuyā chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ || idaṃ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ || || 9
sn14.31:3.1: Yāva kivañcāham bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnam dhātūnaṃ evam assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abbhaññāsiṃ || neva tāvāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ || || 10
sn14.31:4.1: Yato cakkvāham bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnam evam assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ || athāham bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ || || 11
sn14.31:4.3: Akuppā me cetovimutti ayam antimā jāti natthi dāni punabbhavoti || ||
